question: _________ is an exclusive martial dance form of Manipur that includes unique display of skill, creativity and agility in which the performers enact a mock fight sequence
solution:
The correct answer is __** Thang-Ta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thang Ta i**s an exclusive martial dance from **Manipur** that includes the unique display of skill, creativity, and agility in which dance performers enact a mock fight sequence. 
 
• **Thang Ta** is an ancient **Manipuri Martial Art** developed from the war environment of **Manipur **& created by the Meitei.
 
• It is also known as the **art of sword and spear,** this Manipuri traditional dance features a wide range of martial arts weaponry in its performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Singhi Chham** or **Kanchendzonga** Dance is a lion dance form in **Sikkim** whereby the dancers perform in a lion costume that represents the **snow lion.**
 
• **Singhi Chamm** is a dance of the **Bhutani people** and was told to have been established by **Chador Namgyal**, the third **Chogyal of Sikkim**, at the time of the 18th century.
 
• **Chakyar Koothu** is a dance performance art in **Kerala**, India. It is firstly a type of highly refined speech where the performer relates episodes from** Hindu epics (such as the Ramayana and the Mahabharata**) and stories from the** Puranas.**
 
• The **Rangma dance** is a representation of battle culture in **Nagaland**. The dancers dressed up as warriors and move to the beat of a drum in a rhythmic method.
